items.title: Business model
items.what_to_check: How the company makes money, who pays and what drives demand.

items.title: Industry conditions
items.what_to_check: Source/date of market data and who prepared or paid for the report.

items.title: Revenue and profit growth
items.what_to_check: Trend across all disclosed years, not one isolated period.

items.title: Operating cash flow
items.what_to_check: Whether accounting profit converts into operating cash.

items.title: Debt and interest burden
items.what_to_check: Debt level, cost and whether issue proceeds repay it.

items.title: ROE and ROCE
items.rhp_section: Basis for Issue Price / financial statements
items.what_to_check: Compare with the issuer's stated peers and definitions.

items.title: Valuation versus peers
items.what_to_check: Multiples at the price band, peer source and date.

items.title: Fresh issue vs OFS
items.what_to_check: How much money reaches the company versus sellers.

items.title: Use of proceeds
items.what_to_check: Specific / general purposes and disclosed deployment schedule.

items.title: Litigation and contingent liabilities
items.what_to_check: Parties, amounts, status and contingent exposure.

items.title: Promoter holding and lock-in
items.what_to_check: Pre/post issue ownership, pledges if disclosed and lock-in.

items.title: Customer concentration
items.what_to_check: Revenue share of major customers and dependencies.

items.title: Related-party transactions
items.what_to_check: Scale, nature, counterparties and disclosed approvals.

items.title: GMP limitations
items.what_to_check: Unofficial, unregulated, source-dependent and not predictive.

items.title: Subscription / market conditions
items.what_to_check: Category-wise demand; oversubscription alone says nothing about business value.
